gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.status..en: Stand on the tuning plate on top. Every second it wears away a little of your matrix damage
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.status..zh: 站到顶上的调律盘上，它每秒替你抹掉一些矩阵损伤

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.status..en: Matrix damage goes down every second. It only touches the damage itself, so corruption effects you already have stay until a Soul Pentacle cures them
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.status..zh: 矩阵损伤每秒往下降。它只管损伤本身，身上已有的腐化效果还得去灵魂五芒星治

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.status..en: The player standing on it has no matrix damage, so nothing is charged
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.status..zh: 站在上面的人没有矩阵损伤，什么都不扣

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.status..en: It pulls ESPE from crystal pillars two blocks away at the same height (8 spots in a ring). Add pillars or wait for them to fill
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.status..zh: 它从同一高度、隔一格的一圈 8 个位置上的水晶柱抽 ESPE。多摆几根柱子，或者等柱子攒满

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.status..en: Put a Bound Gem linked to an MRU source into the slot on the right
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.status..zh: 在右边的格子里放一颗绑在 MRU 源上的绑定宝石

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.status..en: In private mode it only tunes the player who placed it. The owner or an operator can switch it to public with the button below
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.status..zh: 私人模式下它只给放下它的人调律。主人或管理员可以用下面的按钮切成公开

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.status..en: Matrix tuners do nothing in this world
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.status..zh: 这个世界里的矩阵调律器不工作

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.mode.hi.en: Private: only the owner gets tuned. Public: anyone standing on it, the owner first. Only the owner or an operator can switch
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.mode.hi.zh: 私人：只给主人调。公开：谁站上去都调，主人优先。只有主人或管理员能切换

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.not.en: Only the player who placed this tuner, or an operator, can switch its mode
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.not.zh: 只有放下这台调律器的人或管理员能切换模式

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.en: Stand on it to wear away matrix damage, paid for in ESPE and MRU. It never cures corruption effects
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_tuner.zh: 站上去，花 ESPE 和 MRU 抹掉矩阵损伤，不治腐化效果
